Maya Gupta: hi all, first oncall week here — hit two things: can't access the incident runbooks in the repo (403) and my pager test shows delivered but no sound on mobile. any quick checks? :slightly_smiling_face:
Ravi Singh: welcome Maya! for the repo, are you using your SSO via ssh or https? we prefer ssh keys for repo access.
Maya Gupta: using HTTPS with my company email. error: 'fatal: unable to access "https://git.redwood.com/runbooks.git/": the requested URL returned error: 403'
Lena Ortiz: send your Okta session link and i'll check groups. quick workaround: use `gh auth login` + `ssh` if you need immediate read.
Maya Gupta: okta session link posted in DM to Lena. also PagerDuty says delivered, but my phone is on DND during focus hours — is there a fallback?
Ravi Singh: PD routing goes to mobile + email by default. we also have audible fallback to a landline if you enable "Emergency Call" in PD profile. check Settings -> Notification Rules.
Oncall Bot: PagerDuty delivery log: test_alert_1832009999 -> delivered to maya.gupta@redwood.com (email), mobile: delivered (silenced)
Lena Ortiz: you're missing `oncall-rotation` group in Okta; added you. Try cloning again.
Maya Gupta: clone succeeded after the group add, thanks!
Ravi Singh: for mobile sound, toggle PD setting to "Override Do Not Disturb" or add a second contact method. Also install the PD mobile app and enable critical alerts in iOS settings (Settings -> Notifications -> PagerDuty).
Maya Gupta: enabled override and tested, I got the audible ping. thanks. any tips for the first shadow shift?
Lena Ortiz: we'll pair you with a responder for the first two shifts. focus on: 1) acknowledging alerts, 2) running `runbook lookup <svc>`, 3) posting a one-line update to #incidents, 4) escalate if no progress in 15m. We also recommend keeping the incident template handy: `sev | symptom | impact | mitigation | next steps`
Maya Gupta: got it. where's the incident template?
Lena Ortiz: in the runbooks repo under docs/incident-template.md and in Confluence -> Oncall Playbook.
Maya Gupta: perfect. thank you both! :raised_hands:
Oncall Bot: Reminder: Complete "Oncall Shadow Lab" in the Learning Portal before your first live shift to get full permissions.
